extraction_notes: Curves were digitized from vector curve geometry in the supplied PDF, preserving the published linear or logarithmic axes and SI units.
The LL4148 typical forward trace in Fig. 1 and the lower reverse-current trace in Fig. 3 were digitized; the separately labeled scattering-limit traces were not treated as nominal LL4148 data.
Fig. 4 is a typical capacitance curve at f = 1 MHz and Tj = 25 degC, but the figure does not separately label LL4148 versus LL4448, so that source ambiguity is retained in the test conditions.
The datasheet also gives reverse current maximum 5 uA at VR = 75 V, Tj = 25 degC; the schema has one reverse-current slot, which is represented by the 25 nA maximum at VR = 20 V.

The datasheet also gives an 8 ns maximum reverse-recovery row for IF = IR = 10 mA and iR = 1 mA; the 4 ns maximum row with IF = 10 mA, VR = 6 V, iR = 0.1 x IR, and RL = 100 ohm is represented in the single reverse-recovery slot.
